headline: OpenAI uses AI to improve chip design with AMD
dek: According to OpenAI itself, its models cut circuit area on the Jalapeño chip and helped AMD.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: AI in chip design
body: OpenAI published a report on how it uses its models to improve the physical design of chips, such as Jalapeño (OpenAI).
Work with AMD also appears in the report, the company says (OpenAI).

s3.label: How it works
s3.title: What the model does
s3.body: According to OpenAI, the model rewrites the code that describes the circuits.

points.t: Synopsys tools confirm behavior is preserved (OpenAI).
Measures the trade-off of power, performance and area (OpenAI).

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Reported results
body: The company says standard-cell area fell about 13% in Jalapeño's vector unit (OpenAI).
In the matrix unit the reduction was 10%, OpenAI says.

stat.cap: less area in the vector unit (OpenAI)

items.t: AMD has already included some changes in a recent design (OpenAI).
OpenAI says it partnered to integrate models into tools (OpenAI).
The company says the gains were proven in silicon (OpenAI).

caption.hook: OpenAI says it uses its models to improve chip design, including with AMD.
body: According to OpenAI itself, its models rewrite the code that describes circuits and use Synopsys tools to check that behavior is preserved (OpenAI). On Jalapeño, its first in-house inference chip, the company says it cut about 13% of the area in the vector unit and 10% in the matrix unit.

OpenAI says the optimizations were proven in silicon and that AMD has already included some of the changes in a recent design (OpenAI). The company also says it partnered with Synopsys to bring the models into chip design tools.
